content:
Should

[Verse 1]
[F]auld acquaintance
[C]be forgot, And
[F]never brought to
[Bb]mind? Should
[F]auld acquaintance
[C]be forgot, [A]And
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne? For

[Chorus]
[F]auld lang
[C]syne, my jo, For
[F]auld lang
[Bb]syne, We'll
[F]tak' a cup o'
[C]kindness yet, [A]For
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne. And

[Verse 2]
[F]surely ye'll be
[C]your pint-stoup! And
[F]surely I'll be
[Bb]mine! And we'll
[F]tak' a cup o'
[C]kindness yet, [A]for
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne. For

[Chorus]
[F]auld lang
[C]syne, my jo, For
[F]auld lang
[Bb]syne, We'll
[F]tak' a cup o'
[C]kindness yet, [A]For
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne. We

[Verse 3]
[F]twa hae run a-
[C]bout the braes, And
[F]pou'd the gowans
[Bb]fine; But we've
[F]wander'd mony a
[C]weary fit, [A]Sin'
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne. For

[Chorus]
[F]auld lang
[C]syne, my jo, For
[F]auld lang
[Bb]syne, We'll
[F]tak' a cup o'
[C]kindness yet, [A]For
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne. We

[Verse 4]
[F]twa hae paidl'd
[C]in the burn, Frae
[F]morning sun till
[Bb]dine; But
[F]seas between us
[C]braid hae roar'd [A]Sin'
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne. For

[Chorus]
[F]auld lang
[C]syne, my jo, For
[F]auld lang
[Bb]syne, We'll
[F]tak' a cup o'
[C]kindness yet, [A]For
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne. And

[Verse 5]
[F]there's a hand, my
[C]trusty fiere! And
[F]gie's a hand o'
[Bb]thine! And we'll
[F]tak' a right gude--
[C]willie waught, [A]For
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne. For

[Chorus]
[F]auld lang
[C]syne, my jo, For
[F]auld lang
[Bb]syne, We'll
[F]tak' a cup o'
[C]kindness yet, [A]For
[Dm]auld [Bb]lang [C]
[F]syne.
title: Auld Lang Syne
tuning: E A D G B E
